entries.text: Allah's Name to commence with, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.
Say you (O Beloved), 'I take refuge in the One Who is the Lord of all the people.'
'In the King of all the people.'
'In the God of all the people.'
'From the evil of the one who inculcates evil thoughts in the hearts and withdraws (when one engages himself in the remembrance of Allah).'
'Those who inculcate evil whispers into the hearts of the people.'
